bounded_seams: The PC23 fixture includes a stale Archive/missing.md recent-file entry alongside a valid Daily/2026-09-11.md entry and retains the configured maxLength.

The workflow-only worker builds a read-only in-memory projection that removes paths absent from the mediated fixture file list, preserves valid entry order and records stale-entry, retention and max-length checks in every install/restart/update phase.
The audit requires the PC23 projection to be present and passing across all three phases while preserving mediated persistence, cleanup, return-to-Obsidian state and zero vault writes.
